document.clear.summary: Clear supported test-design contents in place, retaining the cloud file; never saves.

inputs.fileId: Required exact saved DataFile.id, also required in invocation --doc-file-id; discover with document status. No version ID, name or fuzzy matching.
inputs.confirm: Required strict boolean true, including dryRun. Authorizes destroying modified test-design contents without saving.
inputs.dryRun: Optional strict boolean, default false. true performs the same read-only preflight and returns actual contents counts without activation or edits. Unlike --preview, reads Fusion.

limitations: Requires explicit --doc, matching --doc-file-id/data.fileId, saved valid complete writable DataFile, root scope/edit target and supported local parametric Design. Existing unsaved modifications are allowed.

Deletes the audited timeline from marker zero, then surviving canvases/custom graphics, dependent-first user parameters and all entity/Design/Document attributes (including aliases, frames and run markers). Counts span root and descendant component definitions; occurrences are counted separately.

Refuses before mutation: other products including CAM, references, configurations, direct/mesh/custom/unknown history, suppressed/rolled-back timeline, empty/nested groups, flat patterns, decals, PMI, custom coordinate systems, analyses, selection/contact sets, named views or unavailable/invalid audit data. Single-level groups and standalone BRep-only base features are audited; other base contents refuse. Supported history types are listed in docs/DOCUMENT_CLEAR.md.

Verifies every scoped count is zero and the same saved complete writable cloud identity remains. No autosave, cloud deletion, save-as, retry or rollback. SDK/readback failures propagate with possible partial unsaved changes; inspect before another command. Caller saves separately.

Not a new-document reset: retain root/origins, cloud identity/name/location/metadata/versions, units, materials, appearances, rules and view/render/preferences. No live Fusion certification. --preview remains outer-input-only and is not a contents audit. Modeling batches disallowed.

document.save_native.summary: Internal single-save primitive used only by document.save.once.
limitations: Not a public CLI operation. The public receipt-bound document.save.once coordinator is the only supported caller.

document.save.once.summary: Save the exact already-open saved document at most once, then observe cloud publication within a bounded budget.

inputs.requestId: Required stable caller request ID, 1..128 letters/digits/underscore/hyphen; repeated invocation never resubmits the same save.
inputs.operationId: Required nonempty caller operation identity bound into the immutable receipt.
inputs.projectId: Required exact DataFile.parentProject.id; must match --project-id and the open document's current project.
inputs.fileId: Required exact saved DataFile.id; must match --doc-file-id and the open document's current lineage.
inputs.creationId: Required exact open document creationId; must match --doc-id.
inputs.expectedVersion: Required positive baseline DataFile.versionNumber; any drift before submit refuses the save.
inputs.reportPath: Required local durable receipt directory; save and later observe must use the same path.
inputs.confirm: Required strict boolean true authorizing this one save of the exact already-open document.
inputs.description: Optional save description; defaults to an fmcad request-bound description.
inputs.timeBudgetMs: Optional bounded observation budget, positive integer 1..120000 ms; defaults to 30000. It never cancels the save RPC.

limitations: Existing saved document only: no first-save, save-as, file/folder creation, activation, open, close, cold reopen, or foreign-document access. A dirty target must already be active and Fusion idle at the mutation boundary.

Identity and version are checked read-only before the one save and again inside its native handler. A clean document returns status noop with unchanged version and no save call, even when the current DataFile is read-only or still cloud processing; cloudComplete reports the observed bit separately.
An immutable pre-submit receipt is published before the save RPC. Timeout/lost response becomes unknown and is never replayed; use document.save.observe for the original request.

status:accepted means the SDK boolean is true but no status read completed within budget; status:pending means status readback saw publication incomplete; status:complete requires the same file/project/creation lineage, a version newer than the baseline, saved and unmodified document state, and DataFile.isComplete true. Readback errors after submit remain unknown.
No default cold test, refresh/save-as fallback or other specialized workflow is invoked. This operation is separate from references.refresh, component.externalize and document.save_as.

document.save.observe.summary: Observe the durable receipt and current status of an original document.save.once request without submitting another save.

inputs.requestId: Required exact original request ID from document.save.once.
inputs.projectId: Required exact original project ID; must match --project-id and the open target.
inputs.fileId: Required exact original DataFile.id; must match --doc-file-id.
inputs.creationId: Required exact original creationId; must match --doc-id.
inputs.reportPath: Required exact same local receipt directory used by document.save.once.
inputs.timeBudgetMs: Optional bounded read-only observation budget, positive integer 1..120000 ms; defaults to 30000.

limitations: Never calls Document.save, saveAs, open, close, activation or cold reopen. It reads only the existing request receipt and exact currently open document status.
A missing receipt or interrupted submission lock returns unknown; corrupt/mismatched receipts and changed target identity refuse reconciliation. Unknown is not success and no retry is offered.
complete, pending, failed and unknown describe publication evidence only, not model geometry or application correctness.

document.status.summary: Read the explicitly scoped document's saved, modified and cloud processing status.
limitations: Snapshot only: no save, activation, refresh, polling, simulation changes or other mutations. saved means Document.isSaved, not durable cloud completion.

Returns name, creationId, saved, modified, fileId, fileName, version (DataFile.versionNumber), versionId, isComplete, folderId and projectId. Unavailable file metadata is null; API read errors propagate.

isComplete describes the currently observed DataFile, which can still be the original file immediately after save_as. Compare against the returned target and original IDs. creationId is not guaranteed unique across copies.

document.save_as.summary: First-save or save a copy of the scoped document to an explicit existing cloud destination.
limitations: SDK saving is unsupported inside command-related events/command transactions. Invoke separately outside such a transaction; do not put save_as in an MCP command-event transaction or a modeling batch. The handler does not schedule, bypass or detect host transactions. SDK errors propagate.

Only accessible projects in Data.dataProjects (active hub). Exact case-sensitive project ID/name and child-folder name matching; all ambiguous matches rejected. No fuzzy search, automatic projects/folders, hub switching or default destination.

folder is a cloud-logical relative path, not a native filesystem path or folder ID. Empty string selects project root. No leading/trailing slash, empty segments, dot segments, backslashes, colons or control characters; no path normalization.

Rejects existing DataFile names case-insensitively across file types. Preflight is not an atomic cloud reservation: concurrent creation or stale SDK listings remain possible. No overwrite option or automatic retry.

For a saved document, confirm authorizes a new copy and the open document becoming that copy. Returns original/current identity snapshots and target IDs; does not close, reopen or separately save the original.

accepted reports the SDK boolean; pending remains true until readback identifies a different file at the exact target with saved=true, modified=false and isComplete=true. status is complete, pending or failed. A true boolean alone never establishes durable cloud completion. No waiting, event pumping or invented upload percentage; inspect status later. Readback errors after acceptance propagate and can leave an uncertain save; inspect before retrying.

inputs.name: Explicit nonempty document name, not a path. No edge whitespace, trailing dot, dot/dot-dot names, control characters or / \ : * ? " < > |. No extension is added or removed by this operation.
inputs.project: Exact existing project ID or name in the active hub; matching more than one project, including ID/name collisions, is rejected.
inputs.folder: Required existing relative folder path such as Designs/Parts; use the actual empty string for project root. Cloud logical, never native path-mapped.
inputs.expectedFolderId: Optional exact SDK DataFolder.id pin. A different folder ID, including a replacement at the same logical path, refuses before saveAs. It does not create or discover a destination.
inputs.expectedProjectId: Optional exact observed SDK DataProject.id pin in addition to the project name/ID selector. A different project refuses before saveAs. Manufacturing Data workspace IDs are not implicitly converted into SDK IDs.
inputs.confirm: Required boolean true to authorize first save or a saved-document copy. Direct CLI --confirm true is parsed as boolean; JSON string true is not accepted.
inputs.description: Optional document description string; omitted sends an empty string.
inputs.tag: Optional document tag string; omitted sends an empty string.
